title: Triangular truss load path
description: Reusable SVG component showing reactions and axial member forces for a symmetric three-member triangular truss with a vertical apex load.
learningObjectives: Trace a vertical apex load through a symmetric triangular truss into support reactions and distinguish tension from compression.

rights.attribution: Original LearnMat repository contribution; no third-party visual assets or runtime dependencies.

verification.notes: Candidate includes documented analytical self-checks and reproducible check notes. Independent engineering, live browser, screenshot, and accessibility review remain required before approval.
